# 佛說六字神呪王經

**ID:** T1045a
**Volume:** T20
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Byline:** 失譯
**Date:** 502–557
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1045a

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The Recension A (Korean canon line) of an anonymous Eastern-Jìn six-syllable spell-text. The pair T1045A and T1045B (Recension A and B = [KR6j0244](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0244)) preserve two parallel transmissions of the same underlying *Liùzì shénzhòuwáng* text. For the broader *Liùzì* tradition see [KR6j0242](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0242).

**Abstract**

This text is closely related to T1044 ([KR6j0242](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0242)) and T1046 ([KR6j0245](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0245)), all anonymous Eastern-Jìn translations of variants of the *ṣaḍ-akṣarī-vidyā* (six-syllable spell) tradition. The Recension A line preserves the Korean-canon (高麗藏) text, while Recension B ([KR6j0244](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0244)) preserves a parallel Sòng-canon transmission. The variants between A and B are concentrated in the dhāraṇī orthography and minor narrative-frame details. For the broader textual and doctrinal context see [KR6j0242](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0242).
